name: AI/ML API
summary: Official hosted AI/ML API MCP: one connector with access to 10,000+ AI tools and models (web search and crawling, document parsing with OCR, social media and SEO data, chat, image, video, music and speech models, embeddings). Uses an AI/ML API key as a bearer token. Grant only the individual tools you want.
license: Proprietary service; see AI/ML API Terms and Conditions
setup_instructions: Create an API key at https://aimlapi.com/app/keys. In Suparagent, connect this listing and save the key as its bearer token. Model lookups and account checks (ping, account_balance, account_usage, models_list, models_search, models_compare, model_get, models_find_best) are free. Chat, embeddings, image, video, audio and speech generation, OCR and tools_run are billed pay-as-you-go to your AI/ML API account. Grant only the individual tools each agent needs, and grant the paid ones only when an agent should spend credits. Do not paste the key into chat or a tool argument. Documentation: https://docs.aimlapi.com/quickstart/mcp
test_instructions: Grant ping or account_balance to an agent and call it once; both are free. A successful call answers from the server or returns the account balance. An authentication error means the saved bearer token is missing or invalid. Remove the grant if the agent does not need the tool.
